purpose: Edit or inspect code through a token-themed CodeMirror surface with predictable keyboard escape.
anatomy: optional line numbers and fold gutters
behaviorProvider: CodeMirror via @uiw/react-codemirror and local code-theme extensions.

component: Use value when defined, otherwise initialize and maintain local text from defaultValue. On editor changes update local text only uncontrolled and call onValueChange.
Disable indentWithTab and describe Tab/Shift+Tab as navigation to surrounding controls. The default extension set enables CodeMirror behavior without adding a tab-indentation binding.
Set both CodeMirror readOnly and editable=false for readOnly. Preserve a named, described, focusable multiline textbox for reading and selection.
host: Own language-specific validation, saving, dirty state, permissions and native form serialization. CodeEditor is not a named input and has no built-in persistence or submission semantics.
Review custom extensions for editing, accessibility, performance and keybindings. Extensions can change the guarantees supplied by the default bundle, including Tab behavior.

Select YAML, JSON, SQL or Python support from language and append caller extensions after the shared extension bundle. The wrapper does not execute source text.

When folding is enabled, provide fold gutter/keymap and a real named button as folded-content placeholder that unfolds then focuses the editor. The public handle exposes focus, foldAll, unfoldAll and getView.
Treat highlightedLines as inclusive one-based ranges; ignore nonfinite bounds, round inward and clip to current document lines before building decorations.
Update line/column only after document or selection changes. Unless statusBar=false, show caller status content or language/read-only default alongside current line, column and line count.
Own language-specific validation, saving, dirty state, permissions and native form serialization. CodeEditor is not a named input and has no built-in persistence or submission semantics.

Consume code group tokens for this family; nested shared components retain their declared ownership. Keep theme/mode changes in token mappings rather than branching behavioral code.

limitations: Syntax presentation is not semantic validation, linting, execution or sandboxing.
Custom dimensions and extensions require host review; no explicit disabled prop or loading/error lifecycle exists.
